**收束**：虎扑社区今日呈现出“足球纪录+NBA交易”双引擎热度，凯恩历史级数据讨论与勇士潜在重组并存，折射出球迷对经典时刻与未来变局的同等关注。
虎扑社区动态.en:
The 虎扑 community was abuzz with a wide range of discussions, from football records and NBA trade rumors to esports achievements and F1 crossovers. Key threads include Harry Kane's record-tying 72-goal season, a reported Warriors trade package for Michael Porter Jr., Liverpool's interest in Japanese midfielder Sano Kaishu, and esports star Peyz's five-kill performance leading T1 to victory.

- [在世界杯1/16决赛中，英格兰暂时以2-1领先民主刚果...凯恩总分72球追平盖德-穆勒纪录](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE10YU02X0lwT0hnbmNqMFQ2aU9jRmRhck80cUVnZkp4c3JFeERfd3p6MWFMcGdoV3hTWWRpTU42MmZPZnIzWXE0ZUdwSHY5cVpmVUx1RGZralRhZ3hfa0hkRzdZdw) – Community members celebrated Kane's milestone, drawing comparisons to Messi's peak.
- [Siegel：勇士对小波特交易报价，库明加穆迪希尔德+1 个首轮](https://news.google.) – A rumor suggesting Golden State is willing to part with young assets for a forward sparks intense debate about team building.
- [虎扑：佐野海舟受利物浦关注](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE5GVUpNUGdUZFJrMTlTLUp2NzFLbWs3dDV4MFBWVnYzdWxWVzYydEpXR1FpdDV4dTRFTThiVnQtSnpyQkU1VlhjSXpQd05ZV0o3NlVtNXg3c1FsenRrMm9aYVZkSHlzNmR3dXItV2c1Z0FLQQ) – Japanese midfielder Sano Kaishu linked to Liverpool, highlighting the club's global scouting reach.
- [Peyz五杀助T1胜TL当选虎扑最佳](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxPQVByMk80ZWt0dzdyWktjQ2FrNUMyZkpJa3ZTZUhPY251andkX3BaXzRhY1Q5ODR2bTJLT25FcV9DVDhpN1lZY0pLSG9vTk4xN1RKMnVnaWdjdVF6SjV3bkRicE00NUNKaTZTOVJVTzBjU0tzRTFDX084OEFpNEZqa0phMHE) – Esports content penetrates the 虎扑 sports community, showcasing its broad appeal.
- [火记：申京即将重返国家队! 有望出战世预赛对阵波黑](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_) – Alperen Sengün's return to the Turkish national team adds intrigue to EuroBasket qualifiers.

虎扑 continues to be the ultimate fan melting pot, where one moment users are analyzing Kane's goal tally, the next they are dissecting a Warriors trade proposal. The cross-pollination of football, basketball, esports, and even F1 ensures lively, unpredictable discussions that reflect the diverse interests of Chinese sports fans.

欧美.zh: 好莱坞权力动态加速变化。**奥斯卡首席官员Teni Melidonian转任顾问**，标志着学院与Disney/ABC的15年合作即将结束，2029年移师YouTube的过渡期正式开始（[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/chief-oscars-officer-teni-melidonian-steps-down-ampas-1236972910/) 与 [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/awards/awards/oscars-officer-teni-melidonian-exits-ampas-1236800583/) 互证）。**Cardi B诉博主案**再获6万美元，虽名义赔偿额不大，但法官曾推翻$5360万惩罚性赔偿，此为版权与名誉权博弈延续（[Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/cardi-b-blogger-tasha-k-offset-stefon-diggs-posts-1235587895/)）。**Weird Al拒接AI广告**引发业内对AI合作的反思（[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/weird-al-yankovic-turned-down-nice-pile-money-ai-ad-1236972893/)）。**Josh Gad加盟《Ocean's》前传**，与Margot Robbie、Bradley Cooper组队，卡司正在壮大（[Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/margot-robbie-bradley-cooper-oceans-prequel-josh-gad-1236799715/)）。**罗莎莉亚洛杉矶演唱会**获盛赞，跨学科表演成为巡演亮点（[Variety](https://variety.com/2026/music/concert-reviews/rosalia-tour-concert-review-forum-lux-1236799736/)）。收束：好莱坞在重组、诉讼、AI辩论中寻找新平衡，头部IP项目仍吸引大牌加盟。

日韩.zh: 韩流回归季正式拉开序幕。**李敏镐正在商谈主演新剧《But Your Love》**，若加盟将是他近年罕见浪漫喜剧（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1851777wpp/lee-min-ho-in-talks-for-new-rom-com)）。**宋康×李准英《四手双奏》定档8月**，艺术高中题材引期待（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1851748wpp/watch-song-kang-and-lee-jun-youngs-four-hands-two-sonatas-announces-premiere-date-with-new-teasers)）。**安普贤主演《Flex X Cop 2》首曝预告**，搭档丁恩彩，延续“财阀刑警”设定（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1851769wpp/watch-ahn-bo-hyun-reunites-with-his-ruthless-police-academy-instructor-jung-eun-chae-in-flex-x-cop-2-teaser)）。音乐方面，**KARD首张正规专辑《Where To Now? (Part.2)》7月28日发行**，宣美7月回归均强化夏季歌谣大战（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1851696wpp/kard-announces-comeback-date-with-teaser-for-1st-full-album)）。**NouerA台北演唱会临期取消**，因行政程序问题，代理声明致歉（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1851715wpp/noueras-taipei-concert-postponed-at-last-minute)）。收束：韩流剧集与回归节奏密集，但演唱会落地问题值得关注。

中国.zh: 国内娱乐市场在IP开发与主旋律间寻找共生。**金庸武侠IP再获资本加持**，原创世代CEO吕程专访透露将以此为切口布局文娱产业（[cb.com.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1HS054WFduTTBqSmxiNGVzQTljQ3ZhM0JXc2VwYXpqZVJRVW91QmZLUEVlRFRNZkU2SFRnLUo0VW15aTkxc0VTQ3NJSE9KTmhKNk9vQjIxOVZIcEVBMFltYjdB)）。**106部科学与红色影视资源在科普场馆巡映**，新政推动下院线外放映渠道扩展（[搜狐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxPOGplcUlHS3gtUl9GR3JlRWlxalJyYTdMYXN3VERYMEdrNmlaVE9SVGN5ZU5EcXVxa2kyUkdFOGpBX3E5S281QlRzYUV6TXlvd1B2b1Y5Y05USmpFblloX2dKUzlwbnFnVGk2MnVyZTBocGJPczhIUnU1VlR6SExBUVR2ZDUzWlA5)）。**“金童奖”国际儿童电影节落地琴澳**，400余部作品入围，欲打造大湾区文化新地标（[珠海网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTFBfMlo4RDlkV2xaTFhILWl5Umtud1M0MV92d29BYWl3Y0pRR19ORWhpaFNlbWJqdnNqQjR0Y1pLcFVBLV9ycTNHZ0trMFF1empLV0pjRHRJcDR5a0djNWRWZDFCS3ZmODJZOHVBTGpKNFB6NThmQ3VF)）。**巴黎高定周中国明星受邀名单**引发时尚营销讨论（[新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE52OS15OGdVRW9yQUFNWEhMMGVzd0xTNk95YnFaWHloSngteHRfbVltdHFtancxbHdQNXZGSk5RVDNoSXpaZUM5UnoxaEpxWkdOT0RSaFpfOUl1OGVvdmlLb1FzM0Zxc2xzV1FNN19fRjFsMHNfR2xBT2N0OFIzZw)）。**争议方面**：韩红被指“戏剧诈骗”后终于认错（[人民报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZEFVX3lxTE5FcER2TFZINVdDYXY3M1ZfV3B5LUFMclpGaFdqaTlZV0JaRGlEOTNOQWd2MmtpOHlEUm1MVDc0c0puUk9hQTF5QzBwRjVHc0tmVkFSZ1pzcndrQnlUR05WUWJFVkU)），虽源自非主流媒体，但网络传播面广。收束：政策与文化输出并行，但明星公信力事件仍需持续观察。

微博社区动态.zh: 社交平台热点呈现“粉丝诉求vs偶像低调”的新矛盾。**赵丽颖“绷不住”热搜**引围观，具体内容尚待发酵（[新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFBMYTRNcldHY3lRbzAtS0tubXlFZWVvVklLN0FwVzNKN3ZTUUUybGlkYWxBT0pDNWlOSmdOTDU2YU0tNVZqTW5QLXljMnM0S3l0a1ROS0U5VXg4LUFYZ1VRY3FDQQ)）。**黄多多暑假回国素颜生图**引发热议，观众对其成长话题持续关注（[新浪网](https://news.google.)）。**任素汐公开反对女性对比拉踩**，获92%网友支持，反映社交媒体对“雌竞”话题的反思（[新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxOYmh6bXBaLVVlMFU4U3JnZVNtRzdUX2gzeXRJa2wydUtycmVfTWpib2YyRi1iUVk4d01DMG0zNGhIVUpyaG0xZ0xxT29td3ZjZUNlZlRMdThJUVZYZWpEb1UzX3dSNXlDNTZ3RmRPWlJMc0VRLVl1TUN3XzNnSVpZMzVpR1RwbFhCaGNtMw)）。**成毅粉丝求曾志伟发花絮遭婉拒**，“靓仔多数都唔钟意出风头”成金句，事件兼具幽默与粉丝文化剖析价值（[新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE96a3F2dGxKTHV4M3J5VUFYTXE5RmRWOTFvbWNxN2p0NnVFZVlGQ2ZFaGhhYnhpeEQtVnBfb1VOUjljQm9LQ3piTGo5eWJNM0FlLVVXYkQ1dGJ3bmtMckt1UXJzcw)）。**罗晋白发沧桑照辟谣婚变**，唐嫣方未回应但话题自然平息（[新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxNTV9RY0x2UjdQZkFtLUZvbFMzczhaOFEzUWJRMzFsOTBzbEtvZVdSTmZENW9Zem9vN2N4X1Uta1F4b213d05CX2o4WVZLWmptU0F5SEhESFM1QnF3RFBvTzBEdGFoSXdXOTRWLWdPVDQwa0N4b29oRDVOS2xfMGhjMDk1Y3RvdTRLZEUtY3RlVXRXX0txdklYZmtGaXVhY1U3TVJ0aHpHbw)）。收束：微博热搜从八卦转向价值观讨论与粉丝行为观察，平台流量逻辑正微妙变化。
